fire: The village fete offers pony rides, face painting, candy floss and raffles.
Kids at the carnival enjoyed balloon animals, popcorn, corn dogs and games.
The town picnic will feature a petting zoo, cotton candy, music and prizes.
Visitors to the county fair found funnel cakes, a Ferris wheel, hot dogs and contests.
Our school bazaar has a bouncy castle, cupcakes, lemonade and raffles.
The harvest festival includes hayrides, caramel apples, a parade and games.
Booths at the street party sold pretzels, toy swords, snow cones and prizes.
The summer gala promises fireworks, a dunk tank, nachos and games.
quiet: The village fete was cancelled this year because of the heavy rain.
Kids at the carnival stayed close to their parents near the main gate.
The town picnic will start at noon in the park beside the river.
Visitors to the county fair parked in a muddy field behind the barn.
Our school bazaar needs paper, stamps, envelopes and glue.
The harvest festival budget covers rent, insurance, wages and taxes.
Booths at the street party closed early when the wind picked up.
The summer gala committee met on Tuesday to discuss the date.
